versions.subject: add process_creation_automated_collection.yml
versions.detection:
selection_ext:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.doc'
        - '.docx'
        - '.xls'
        - '.xlsx'
        - '.ppt'
        - '.pptx'
        - '.rtf'
        - '.pdf'
        - '.txt'
selection_dir:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'dir '
        - ' /b '
        - ' /s '
selection_findstr:
    OriginalFileName: FINDSTR.EXE
    CommandLine|contains: ' /e '
condition: selection_ext and (selection_dir or selection_findstr)
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*.doc*", "*.docx*", "*.xls*", "*.xlsx*", "*.ppt*", "*.pptx*", "*.rtf*", "*.pdf*", "*.txt*") (CommandLine="*dir *" CommandLine="* /b *" CommandLine="* /s *") OR (OriginalFileName="FINDSTR.EXE" CommandLine="* /e *")
